reason: README明确表明该插件的主要用途是将飞书机器人作为入口，接收用户消息后触发 DeepSeek Harness 任务执行并回写结果；因此按以用户任务自动化与外部通信集成为核心。

summaries.zh: 该插件将 Feishu 飞书机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，供授权用户在聊天内提交任务并接收执行进度与结果。
summaries.en: This plugin connects a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness so authorized users can submit tasks in chat and receive execution progress and results.

capabilities: Bridges Feishu chat messages to execution of dsh tasks and returns results in the same chat.
Supports user authorization and admin approval commands to control who can run tasks.
Supports serial task queuing, runtime heartbeat/progress updates, and execution time/output limits.
Handles inbound/downstream file transfer between Feishu and workspace files with size and location checks.
Persists per-chat/per-user conversation context for follow-up task continuity.

reasons.code: README说明“将飞书机器人连接到 DeepSeek Harness…用户在飞书中发送文字消息后…把消息作为任务交给指定的 dsh profile 执行，并将结果回复到原会话”。
README详细列出 `/request`、`/approve`、`/deny`、`/revoke` 等审批流程，以及 `adminOpenIds`/`allowedOpenIds` 白名单控制。
README描述入站文件下载到 `.dsh-feishu/inbox` 及任务输出文件通过 `DSH_FILE` 或 `/send` 回传到飞书，并进行工作区边界与大小校验。
README提到插件执行期间更新同一条消息、超时与输出长度限制、任务队列与串行执行。
